coder_notes: Pediatric and young adult basket (age 0 to 21; registry stdAges CHILD and ADULT). GBM is eligible in Part 1 only; Part 2 cohorts are melanoma and Hodgkin lymphoma. BRAF mutation in Part 2 melanoma is not an entry requirement, so not listed. PK is serum only. Dostarlimab is a licensed anti-PD-1 but is a tested combination partner here, so coded experimental_combination.
